propositions: The gen_env_registry scanner recognizes only os.environ.get, os.environ[...] subscript, and os.getenv forms; any other accessor like os.environ.pop silently drops its key from docs/env-vars.md with no diagnostic or exit-code signal.

Changing os.environ.get('REBAR_SOMETHING') to os.environ.pop('REBAR_SOMETHING', None) reduces the generated registry count and removes the documented key while the generator exits successfully and make lint passes locally.

The fail-closed fix classifies all os.environ attribute accesses (get, pop, setdefault, __getitem__, copy, keys, values, etc.) and raises UnrecognisedEnvironAccess for any unrecognized form instead of silently skipping.
The make lint target now runs gen_env_registry.py --check to catch staleness locally, aligning local and CI verdicts.
Both os.environ.pop sites in the codebase (opcert_service/config.py and _io/import_ndjson.py) are now correctly registered via the widened recognizer.
